```yaml
name: PR Status Labeler

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request_target:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  capture-pr-data:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v2
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install requests

      - name: Capture PR data
        id: capture_pr_data
        run: |
          echo "::set-output name=pr_number::${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}"
          echo "::set-output name=pr_repo::${{ github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name }}"

  pr-status-labeler:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: capture-pr-data
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v2
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install requests

      - name: Get PR data
        run: |
          pr_number=${{ needs.capture-pr-data.outputs.pr_number }}
          pr_repo=${{ needs.capture-pr-data.outputs.pr_repo }}

      - name: Label PR
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          curl -X POST \
            https://api.github.com/repos/${{ github.repository }}/issues/${{ pr_number }}/labels \
            -H "Authorization: token $GITHUB_TOKEN" \
            -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
            -d '["label1", "label2"]'
```

This updated workflow addresses the issues by using `workflow_dispatch` for manual triggering, which avoids the security concerns associated with `workflow_run`. It also correctly references the `pr_number` output from the `capture-pr-data` job.
